**About 0.5 ha of native forest was lost, roughly 2.8% of the 17.6 ha property.**

- **Event:** Hansen data show 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, after the end-2020 baseline. That is 3.41% of the property.
- **Forest type:** The national forest map (MGAP 2021) classes 0.5 ha of the event area as native forest. The other 0.1 ha lies outside mapped forest. None of it is planted forest.
